title: Cards recycled to pay the cost are placed on the bottom of the Main Deck in deterministic (trash) order rather than random order.
expected: activate-ability.ts:1357-1363 pays the "Recycle N from your trash" cost with a plain for-loop that moveCard()s each chosen id to position "bottom" of mainDeck in list order (trash order / recycleIds order) with no shuffle or randomization. Rule 416.5 (whose own example is Garbage Grabber) requires the simultaneously recycled cards to be placed on the bottom in a random order.
observed: In 3 of 3 activations the 3 recycled cards appeared as the last 3 entries of mainDeck in exactly their trash order (e.g. trash [16,35,9] -> deck bottom [...,16,35,9]; trash [22,3,20,11] -> [...,22,3,20]; trash [11,28,14,19] -> [...,11,28,14]).
